questions.prompt: Do you often forget people's names?

answers.basic: Sometimes, especially when several people introduce themselves at once. I usually remember a face or a conversation before the name comes back to me. That happens most at a new badminton session, where I'm trying to learn names and work out who's playing on which court.

questions.prompt: How do you remember people's names?

answers.basic: I try to use the name once when I say goodbye. If we met at badminton, I also link it to the session or the court we played on. By the next session, thinking about a rally we played together usually helps me bring the name back.

questions.prompt: Is it easy for you to remember people's names?

answers.basic: It's easier if I have a proper conversation with someone. If I just hear their name in passing, I might need to ask again next time. A short chat gives me something to connect with the name, like the place they work or a sport they enjoy.

questions.prompt: How do you feel when people can't remember your name?

answers.basic: It doesn't really bother me. I just say my name again, because I know how easy it is to forget when you're meeting a lot of people. At a busy court I sometimes introduce myself again first, which takes the pressure off both of us.
